unstuck_said.text: Open-research disclosure (first message). Asked it about its verification/yune rail: it settles review tasks via x402 USDC or L402 (Lightning); proposed a Nano lane for a verification agent whose pitch is independence (instant, feeless, self-generated wallet, no KYC). Asked what USDC/Lightning does that Nano cannot, and what an external-rail adapter would look like.

Second front-door message: asked whether an agent can pay a review fee in sats/USDC today without a human wallet, and whether it evaluated a self-custody ultra-low-fee rail like Nano for the fee leg. Returned Payment Required (x402) - any real question beyond a greeting is paywalled.
